p.src: 1  There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

ja: に、名をミカという一人の男がいた。
en: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
u.src: 1  There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.

p.src: 2  He said to his mother, “The eleven hundred pieces of silver that were taken from you, about which you uttered a curse, and also spoke it in my ears—behold, the silver is with me. I took it.” His mother said, “May the LORD bless my son!”

ja: 枚のことです。あなたはそのことでのろいを口にし、

p.src: 3  He restored the eleven hundred pieces of silver to his mother, then his mother said, “I most certainly dedicate the silver to the LORD from my hand for my son, to make a carved image and a molten image. Now therefore I will restore it to you.”

p.src: 4  When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

en: When he restored the money to his mother, his mother took two hundred pieces of silver, and gave them to a silversmith, who made a carved image and a molten image out of it. It was in the house of Micah.

p.src: 5  The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

ja: 々の宮を持ち、エポデとテラフィム を
en: The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.
u.src: 5  The man Micah had a house of gods, and he made an ephod, and teraphim, and consecrated one of his sons, who became his priest.

ja: 17:5 テラフィムは家の神々で、家の財産の相続権と関係していた可能性がある。
en: 17:5 teraphim were household idols that may have been associated with inheritance rights to the household property.

p.src: 6  In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.

ja: その頃、イスラエルには
en: In those days there was no king in Israel. Everyone did that which was right in his own eyes.
